name: AI Safety Benchmark v0.5
description: The AI Safety Benchmark v0.5 is designed to assess safety risks of AI systems using chat-tuned language models, covering a single use case with multiple personas and a taxonomy of 13 hazard categories. It includes 43,090 test items created with templates, a grading system, and an evaluation platform called ModelBench.
reputation: A relatively new but well-cited safety benchmark from the AI safety evaluation literature, used to probe harmful behavior and policy compliance in chat models.
notes: v0.5 is an early release with documented limitations; v1.0 planned for end of 2024.
